entries.fault: Intermittent pressure drop to 2850 PSI during high-demand operations
entries.action: Filter replaced. Pump output monitoring in progress.

entries.fault: EGT margin trending high — 15°C above Engine 1 baseline
entries.action: FADEC data reviewed. Fuel nozzles checked. Trend monitoring continues.

entries.fault: Start time exceeding normal parameters (62s vs 45s normal)
entries.action: Inlet door lubricated. Starter brushes inspected — slight wear noted.

entries.fault: Intermittent BLEED 1 FAULT — valve response delay
entries.action: Bleed valve replaced per AMM 36-11-01. System tested satisfactory.

entries.fault: Increased operating force required — crew reports stiffness
entries.action: Hinge bearings lubricated. Door operation verified satisfactory.

entries.fault: Slat channel 1 position disagreement during pre-flight check
entries.action: Sensors re-rigged per AMM 27-81-01. Full cycle test satisfactory.

entries.fault: Cabin zone 2 temperature not controllable below 26°C
entries.action: Trim air valve actuator replaced per AMM 21-61-01. Post-repair temp range normal.

entries.fault: Bleed air leak detected at precooler duct — abnormal heat in zone
entries.action: Duct clamp tightened. Leak check clear. Monitoring after engine runs.

entries.fault: Fluctuating reservoir quantity indication on ECAM
entries.action: Connector cleaned and secured. Indication stable after ground test.

entries.fault: Oil leak at accessory gearbox cover area
entries.action: Gasket replaced per AMM 71-11-05. Oil replenished. No leak after run.
